plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Graphic Design - UX/UI Emphasis program page (poid=11048) and its linked official degree map, 'Graphic Design Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'UX/UI Emphasis (Campus)' (the workbook has no Online tab; its Index lists Online as N/A), last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major and transfer students must earn at least 50% of their art credits from SUU (the catalog page for this emphasis does not carry the laptop-computer bullet printed on the Graphic Design page); the map prints a 'BFA Program Application Due' marker in Fall Year 2 (no course, no credits, not recorded as a course row). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/16/15/15/15/15/15/13) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BFA Degree: 120. The catalog's Graphic Design - UX/UI Curriculum (79 credits) is exercised exactly by the map: BFA Art Foundation 25 (every named course placed, including ARTH 2710 and ARTH 2720, which also carry GE Humanities tags); Graphic Design Requirements 39 (every named course placed, with the Complete One of the Following art-history choice exercised as the map's Spring Year 3 upper-division art history slot, and ART 4890 Internship recorded at the 3 credits the catalog requires of its 0.5-12 range); UX/UI Emphasis Requirements 15 (ART 3360, ART 3560 and ART 4360 placed as named rows, and the Complete Two of the Following choice exercised as the map's two 3-credit 'ART Major UX/UI Emphasis Course' rows). DISCLOSED, not placed: the catalog's Graphic Design Requirements block also lists a Senior BFA Exhibition at 0 credits; it carries no course code in the catalog and has no row on the map, so it is recorded here rather than as a course row (0 credits, so no total is affected). DISCLOSED MAP-VS-CATALOG DIFFERENCE, transcribed as printed: the map prints one 3-credit 'ART/ARTH Major Art or Art History Elective' row in Spring Year 2, but this emphasis's catalog page has no Art Electives block (its curriculum is 25 + 39 + 15 = 79 with no elective block); the row is recorded as an elective choice slot exactly as the map prints it, and the map remains the university's own reconciliation to the printed 120 total. The map's free-elective rows total 16 credits as printed (6/3/3/4); the catalog prints no free-elective figure, and its recommended electives CSCY 2000 and COMM 2010 are the annotations printed on the map's Fall Year 3 and Fall Year 4 free-elective rows. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them (ART 4790 Senior BFA Studio I: Professional Practices and Portfolio Systems; ART 4800 Senior BFA Studio II: BFA Exhibition and Portfolio Completion).
